svg.desc: role: AI Developer · ML Researcher. education: B.Tech CSE (AI) · Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham · 2023–2027. location: Coimbatore, India. building: Satellite air-pollution forecasting over Chennai (final-year project). focus: LLMs & RAG · Deep Learning · Computer Vision · Backend & Full-Stack. community: Competitive Programming vertical, IETE SF Club. open to: Internships · Research collaborations · Hackathons.
